boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bryn Mawr College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe stops on campus and along nearby Lancaster Avenue, each with currently documented evening or late-night access.

cards.title: Coffee Below Canaday
cards.subtitle: An on-campus café open until midnight on semester weeknights
cards.notes: Head to Canaday Library’s basement Sunday through Thursday; confirm the semester calendar because the café closes for summer.
cards.short_summary: The campus’s latest officially documented café window runs from 8 p.m. to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryn Mawr College identifies The Lusty Cup as a late-night café in Canaday Library and lists semester hours of 8 p.m.–midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Semester hours are Sunday–Thursday, 8 p.m.–midnight; closed during summer. It is not included in the meal plan.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Campus Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Late café service inside the Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center stop for an evening meal; check whether semester or reduced summer hours apply before setting out.
cards.short_summary: UnCommon Grounds pairs a late-night menu with an on-campus 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: The college lists semester café and kitchen hours through 11 p.m. on weekdays and a weekend night service from 8–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: During semesters, weekday café and kitchen service runs until 11 p.m.; weekend night service is listed from 8–11 p.m. Summer hours are shorter.

cards.title: Cookies After Midnight
cards.subtitle: A Lancaster Avenue bakery built around late delivery
cards.notes: Check the live store page before ordering, then choose pickup or delivery; this branch advertises cookie delivery as late as 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Bryn Mawr cookie shop supplies the board’s after-midnight dessert option.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies maintains a dedicated Bryn Mawr store page advertising warm-cookie delivery until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Warm Cookies Delivered Until 3 AM Daily | Insomnia Cookies
cards.access_notes: The official Bryn Mawr store page advertises delivery until 3 a.m. daily; verify pickup and delivery availability in the live ordering interface.

cards.title: Pizza at the Midnight Mark
cards.subtitle: A Bryn Mawr carryout and delivery counter open to midnight
cards.notes: Place the order before the posted cutoff and verify whether carryout or delivery is still accepting orders at your address.
cards.short_summary: This Lancaster Avenue branch provides a clearly documented midnight pizza window.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page identifies its Bryn Mawr restaurant at 1215 Lancaster Avenue and reports that it is open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1215 Lancaster Ave | Domino's in Bryn Mawr
cards.access_notes: The official location page reported service until 12 a.m. when fetched; hours vary by day, so confirm the live Hours section before ordering.

cards.title: An 11 P.M. Pizza Build
cards.subtitle: Custom pizza on East Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday, when the posted closing extends an hour later than the Sunday-through-Thursday schedule.
cards.short_summary: Snap’s weekend schedule stretches custom-pizza service to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Snap Custom Pizza’s official location page lists the Bryn Mawr/Rosemont shop at 1125 East Lancaster Avenue and Friday–Saturday hours until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Bryn Mawr/Rosemont | Hours + Location | Snap Custom Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday, according to the official location page.

cards.title: A Late Italian Seating
cards.subtitle: Weekend dinner near Bryn Mawr station
cards.notes: Reserve before the 10:30 p.m. Friday-or-Saturday last seating; the kitchen’s documented weekend cutoff is 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Otto’s later weekend seating creates a sit-down alternative to counter-service runs.
cards.evidence_claim: Otto by Polpo’s official website lists a 10:30 p.m. last seating and an 11 p.m. kitchen close on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday last seating is 10:30 p.m., with the kitchen closing at 11 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday service ends earlier.

cards.title: Moroccan Food Near Midnight
cards.subtitle: A late Lancaster Avenue dining room
cards.notes: Call before making a very late trip; the map listing shows service deep into the night, but posted schedules can change independently.
cards.short_summary: This named Bryn Mawr restaurant adds a non-pizza, late-evening meal option.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Apple Maps place page identifies White House Tajine at 1047 West Lancaster Avenue and lists daily hours extending to 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: White House Tajine in Bryn Mawr, PA United States - Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Apple Maps lists daily hours of 8 a.m.–3 a.m.; because other booking channels may differ, call the restaurant before relying on after-midnight service.

cards.title: The 11 P.M. Supply Stop
cards.subtitle: Late essentials beside the Lancaster Avenue food cluster
cards.notes: Use the front store for snacks or practical supplies before 11 p.m.; the pharmacy and MinuteClinic close substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: A late front-store window covers the unglamorous but useful supply run.
cards.evidence_claim: CVS’s official Bryn Mawr locator lists the store at 1218 East Lancaster Avenue and reports Store & Photo hours through 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: CVS Near Me | Bryn Mawr, PA | CVS Pharmacy Locations
cards.access_notes: Store & Photo closes at 11 p.m.; pharmacy and MinuteClinic hours end earlier. Check the live listing for holiday changes.

cards.title: The 9 P.M. Slice Window
cards.subtitle: A straightforward Lancaster Avenue pizza counter
cards.notes: Go earlier in the evening and call when online ordering is disabled; Friday and Saturday carry the latest posted 9 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: Johnny’s marks the earlier edge of the local late-night circuit with weekend pizza service.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnny’s official Bryn Mawr website lists Friday and Saturday hours until 9 p.m. at 1025 West Lancaster Avenue.
cards.source_title: Johnny's Pizza | Dine-in Takeout Delivery | Bryn Mawr
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday hours run until 9 p.m.; Tuesday–Thursday close at 8:30 p.m., Sunday at 8 p.m., and Monday is closed.

cards.title: The Conestoga Road Closing Run
cards.subtitle: Pizza, wings, and sandwiches until 9 p.m.
cards.notes: Choose Wednesday through Saturday for the latest posted close, and submit pickup orders with enough time for kitchen preparation.
cards.short_summary: Zesto anchors a practical 9 p.m. food run south of central Lancaster Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Zesto’s official Bryn Mawr website lists its 908 Conestoga Road location as open until 9 p.m. Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Home | Zesto Pizza & Grill - Bryn Mawr
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. Wednesday–Saturday; Sunday–Tuesday close at 8 p.m. Confirm holiday hours before traveling.
